parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Misskey instance by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-misskey` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Misskey instance — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional Misskey instances bound per enrollment.
